name: Eco Sprint
notes: Reach tier 3 and gather as much as possible in 10 minutes against the idle bot (level 0). Not a ladder and not a win or loss: the judge reports the time to tier 3 and the gathered amount, to be compared with the anchors (null agent, mock). The cutoff at 600 s is the normal end. Board cell: 2 seats x 4 maps = 8 games (no bot style at level 0). The board list is frozen in SEEDS-HASH.txt.
